const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Limited-mode BEHAVIOR-1K shoe-rack episode controller.
+
+This script deliberately exposes small base motions and calibrated RGB captures;
+it keeps the current 22 trunk/arm/finger joints fixed during base moves.
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+RUNS = OUT / "runs"
+RUNS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+CAM_HEAD = "robot_r1:zed_link:Camera:0"
+CAM_L = "robot_r1:left_realsense_link:Camera:0"
+CAM_R = "robot_r1:right_realsense_link:Camera:0"
+
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+counter = 0
+latest = r.get_obs(video="frames")
+latest.save(str(RUNS / "000_initial"))
+print("connected", r.base, flush=True)
+print("initial meta", {k: latest.meta.get(k) for k in ("step", "sim_time_s", "time_left_s", "done")}, flush=True)
+
+
+def capture(label=None, seconds=0.0):
+    """Capture all three cameras and save an inspectable observation."""
+    global latest, counter
+    latest = r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video="frames")
+    counter += 1
+    name = label or f"obs_{counter:03d}"
+    latest.save(str(RUNS / name))
+    print(name, {k: latest.meta.get(k) for k in ("step", "sim_time_s", "time_left_s", "done", "reason")}, flush=True)
+    return latest
+
+
+def joints_now():
+    global latest
+    if latest is None:
+        latest = r.get_obs(video="frames")
+    return np.asarray(latest.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)
+
+
+def base(dx=0.0, dy=0.0, dyaw=0.0, n=1, dt=1/30, note="base move", video="mp4"):
+    """Apply body-frame base deltas for n control rows, holding joints fixed."""
+    global latest, counter
+    assert n >= 1 and n <= 300
+    p = joints_now()
+    # q_0..q_5 are the mobile-base wheel DOFs; q_6..q_27 are trunk/arms/grippers.
+    arm_trunk = p[6:28]
+    row = np.r_[np.clip([dx, dy, dyaw], [-.15, -.15, -.3], [.15, .15, .3]), arm_trunk]
+    actions = np.tile(row, (n, 1))
+    res = r.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=dt, interpolate="hold", video=video, note=note)
+    counter += 1
+    res.save(str(RUNS / f"{counter:03d}_{note.replace(' ', '_')}"))
+    latest = r.get_obs(video="frames")
+    print("base", (dx, dy, dyaw, n), "result", {k: res.meta.get(k) for k in ("done", "reason", "control_steps_chunk", "clipped", "plan")}, "now", {k: latest.meta.get(k) for k in ("step", "sim_time_s", "time_left_s", "done")}, flush=True)
+    return res
+
+
+def reach_pose(left=None, right=None, lgrip=None, rgrip=None, note="eef pose", video="mp4"):
+    """One synchronized world-frame EE waypoint; omitted arms hold observed poses."""
+    global latest, counter
+    p = joints_now()
+    now = latest.meta["proprio"]["now"]
+    if left is None:
+        left = now[35:42]
+    if right is None:
+        right = now[42:49]
+    if lgrip is None:
+        lgrip = 1.0
+    if rgrip is None:
+        rgrip = 1.0
+    row = np.r_[np.asarray(left[:7], dtype=np.float32), float(lgrip),
+                np.asarray(right[:7], dtype=np.float32), float(rgrip)]
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", row[None, :], video=video, note=note)
+    counter += 1
+    res.save(str(RUNS / f"{counter:03d}_{note.replace(' ', '_')}"))
+    latest = r.get_obs(video="frames")
+    print("eef", {k: res.meta.get(k) for k in ("done", "reason", "plan", "clipped")}, "now", {k: latest.meta.get(k) for k in ("step", "sim_time_s", "time_left_s", "done")}, flush=True)
+    return res
+
+
+def show_state():
+    p = joints_now()
+    return {"base": p[28:35].tolist(), "left_eef": p[35:42].tolist(), "right_eef": p[42:49].tolist(),
+            "meta": {k: latest.meta.get(k) for k in ("step", "sim_time_s", "time_left_s", "done", "reason")}}
+
+
+print("helpers: capture(label=None,seconds=0), base(dx,dy,dyaw,n), reach_pose(left,right,lgrip,rgrip), show_state()", flush=True)
+
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));

    """Apply body-frame base deltas for n control rows, holding joints fixed."""
    global latest, counter
